issues.quote: Net income fell 3.4% to $110.1 billion in fiscal 2024 from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Apple's FY2024 net income was about $93.7 billion, not $110.1 billion. $110.1B would be a ~13.5% increase over $97.0B, which contradicts the stated 3.4% decline. The 3.4% decline matches $93.7B.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit and margin, operating income and margin, R&D and EPS are all correct. The FY2024 net income figure is wrong: it should be ~$93.7B, not $110.1B. The decline came mainly from a one-time ~$10.2B tax charge.
